en: No, think nothing of it, miss.
Since we've met, may I ask your name?
My name is Sylvia.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
But it's strange. Seeing you there,
I somehow felt I had to say hello
That's quite all right. I'm honored.
I hope we meet again, Sylvia.
How strange. We've only just met, yet
it's somehow like meeting someone dear
I hope we meet again. Goodbye.
You look well. I'm so glad.
Somehow, seeing you puts me at ease.
, is that you?
note: After the name; a pause follows, then a new line.

en: Oh, I knew it was you.
Are you feeling well today?
<Very well indeed>
<A bit under the weather...>
I'm so glad. That's a relief.
note: Answer to #7056; not decoded by talk.py (branch start lost).

en: You always seem livelier at night, somehow.
Oh my, what's wrong? I'm worried.
It's just a feeling, but by day you always seem
so tired. Please take care of yourself.
How may I help you?
No, I only came to see where this place is.
Pardon the intrusion.
note: Also used by the player at Virginia's salon (msg 324674), wrong house.

en: Oh, I see.
Please come again. Thank you.
How may I help you?... Oh,
hello! Welcome to our bank.
Will you be making a deposit?
Hello, Sylvia.
I'm afraid I'm only dropping by today.
I'm also getting my bearings.
Do come to us to make your deposits.
I'll be waiting for you.
Welcome, and thank you for coming.
What brings you here today?
I'll help you any way I can.
, you're
note: After the name; #7080 continues on the next line.

en: quite an amusing man.
Is coming to the bank really so much fun?
Since you're here, how about a deposit?
Perhaps I should.
It would be a fine excuse to see you.
Oh my, hee hee, stop it.
So you make jokes like that, too.
I'm flattered. Thank you.
I won't ask about deposits anymore.
Come by whenever you like. Hee hee hee.
The work is tedious, but I
really like this job.
Oh... hello.
Who might you be? How can I help you?
Pardon me. I came to introduce myself.
I've only just moved to this area.
Oh, I see. How very kind of you.
My name is Sylvia.
I hope we'll get along. Good day.
Have you come again?
Did you lose your way? Hee hee.
Oh,
note: Before the name; #98 gives '.'. Also Beth msg 394745.

en: What is it?
You come to see me so often lately.
Did you forget something?
Won't you come in for once?
You come to see me so often, yet you always
leave right away.
You came to see me again.
Um... shall we meet somewhere sometime?
I'd love a longer talk with you.
Um, excuse me, miss.
I'm new here and don't know the area well.
. And you?
Come to the bank, and you'll find me there.
Good idea. I'll come by sometime.
Thank you for your kindness, Sylvia.
Oh my, we meet again. Hee hee.
what luck! Something good's sure to happen.
note: After #7034 (slice 087) ending in a comma; matches #7035.

en: Thank you. Have a good day yourself.
